title: Yellow Spiced Ethiopian Rigatoni Shiro
description: A cultured and romantic Ethiopian dish featuring rigatoni, katsuramuki-cut vegetables, and a blend of aromatic spices, made Whole30-friendly and served in a traditional shiro form.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and saute the katsuramuki-cut onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in the berbere spice and turmeric, and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked rigatoni to the skillet, tossing to combine with the spice mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken broth and a pinch of salt, then pour the mixture over the rigatoni and spice mixture.
Simmer the mixture over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has been absorbed and the rigatoni is coated in the spicy shiro sauce.
Serve the Yellow Spiced Ethiopian Rigatoni Shiro hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
